config.scope: ONE seed, TWO internal basic-block consumers. Standalone post-pruning diagnostic from the selected Q ResNet baseline, not reuse of an all-nine-sites compressed network. Remaining seven blocks fixed during fitting, all parameters train during identical3ep repair. Reference budget is actual full-model count with only these two hidden widths halved; unchanged residual outputs. Per-layer width/type selected jointly under <= that exact budget, slack reported. Controls: Q-only, Q/real-only, uniform learned PHM4, variable n and a same-catalogue weight-only-error selector. Infeasible policy recorded as skipped, never silently increases budget. All candidate fitting/selection uses500 fit images; separate500 calibration check and1000 validation do not tune choices. Same one-shot catalogue for all controls.
config.method: Prespecified BN-folded producer magnitude ranks retained Q units, nested kept sets for widths. Both direct-Q and dense output reconstruction use common dense-kernel Frobenius ridge; Q coefficient ridge scaled4 to match expanded-kernel norm. PHM candidates use Kronecker SVD of the output-fitted dense oracle, then ACTUAL float32 activation-output fit MSE selects structures. SVD itself minimizes weight error only; weighted ALS not implemented. One hard type/n per layer, no soft ensemble. Basis parameters remain stored/trainable and count in deployment. rank r=n only in this first catalogue; n4 learned PHM distinct from fixed Hamilton. No new solver/theorem/novelty claim.
config.queue_gate: --prepare uses CPU synthetic data only. --run refuses until both required earlier study summaries exist with status completed, as well as completed ResNet baselines and unchanged registered inputs/sources. Does not create missing core/replication workers. Current baseline GPU process is untouched. STOP pauses between fits/policies or after a repair batch; epoch resume uses existing checked helper.
